# LitigaForge AI

> LitigaForge AI is a global AI-powered platform 
providing expert guidance in legal, financial, 
health, and business matters. Trusted by clients 
across India and worldwide.

## Core Services

- [Legal AI](/legal) - Court cases, contracts, 
  disputes, rights, consumer protection
- [Document Analyzer](/document-analyzer) - 
  AI-powered legal document review and drafting
- [Legal Q&A](/legal-qa) - Instant answers to 
  legal questions in plain language
- [Match Proposals](/match-proposals) - Connect 
  with verified lawyers instantly
- [Free Legal Aid](/free-legal-aid) - NALSA 
  resources and eligibility checker
- [Judgment Finder](/judgments) - Search Indian 
  court judgments by keyword or CNR
- [AI Legal Chat](/ai-legal-chat) - Real-time 
  legal guidance via AI

## Coverage Areas
- Motor accident claims
- Consumer disputes  
- Property and tenancy law
- Criminal law basics
- Family and matrimonial law
- Contract disputes
- Employment law

## Jurisdictions
India (Telangana, Andhra Pradesh), with global 
legal reference capability
